info.title: Kitsuden API — kon SDK operations
info.description: Every operation declared with defineOperation by the installed kons and the core. Generated by apps/api/scripts/sdk-openapi.ts; input of the typed clients (pnpm sdk:generate).

tags.name: kon-agent-notifications
tags.description: Where an agent is told that its proposals were resolved (administrators only).

tags.name: kon-agents
tags.description: Agent permissions, keys and quotas (admin only).

tags.name: kon-approvals
tags.description: Human approval of agent proposals (team members only; never an agent).

tags.name: kon-blocks
tags.description: Lego-style block system for dynamic page layouts with drag & drop. Includes Hero, Text, Image, Video, Grid, Cards, Quote, CTA, Embed, Divider, and Spacer blocks.

tags.name: kon-brain
tags.description: Agent memory: notes with an owner (private by default, optionally shared), connections with provenance, claims with evidence, OKF export and graphify import.

tags.name: kon-datasets
tags.description: Dynamic data collections with automatic REST API

tags.name: kon-external-mcp
tags.description: External MCP servers and the human review of their tools (human administrators only).

tags.name: kon-media
tags.description: Media file management with S3/MinIO storage

tags.name: kon-models
tags.description: The models declared with defineModel in the mounted kons (for the admin panel).

tags.name: kon-oauth
tags.description: Consent and connected-client management for OAuth MCP clients (human admins and editors only).

tags.name: kon-promotion
tags.description: Code promotion: an agent submits versioned drafts of a code action's code; they are tested in the sandbox, scanned and activated by a human approval (suggestion) or automatically when nothing widens permissions (turbo), with a watch window and automatic rollback.

tags.name: kon-promotion-admin
tags.description: Code promotion for admins: settings, agents' modes, approve, reject, roll back and activate (humans only).

tags.name: kon-proposals
tags.description: An agent reads the status and result of its own proposals.

tags.name: kon-queue
tags.description: The Postgres queue: status and dead jobs (administrators only).

tags.name: kon-record-history
tags.description: The change history of the rows of any explorable table (for the admin panel).

tags.name: kon-traces
tags.description: The glass box: one trace per request, in Postgres (administrators only).

post.description: Executes the stored request once, with the agent's CURRENT identity and permissions, and records the approver. A second approval gets 409. If the agent was deactivated, its key revoked or expired, or its permission removed, the proposal ends as failed without executing. With `fields` (a proposal that writes a record), only the fields it accepts are executed, with any edited value; a field the list leaves out is rejected, and every field rejected is a rejection. `reviewAt` schedules a later review.

post.summary: Submit a code draft for an action
post.description: Submits a new VERSION of a code action's code (the active version is never edited). The draft's tests (plus the tests the action declares) run in the sandbox with simulated `kitsuden.api` and `fetch`; a local security scan checks the code and the DECLARED capabilities (scopes, outbound hosts, limits) are compared with the active version. Then: suggestion mode → a proposal for a human (status awaiting_approval, proposal id in the response); turbo mode → activated at once ONLY if every test and check passes and nothing widens permissions or touches secrets, users, roles, security config or sensitive operations; otherwise a proposal with the reasons (`decision.reasons`). Resubmitting the same content returns the same version (200, duplicate: true). Agents only; never approves anything.

x-kitsuden-guide.whenToUse: To change (or create) the code of a code action. Never edit an action's code directly: submit a draft with tests; it is tested in the sandbox, scanned and then either activated automatically (turbo mode, only when nothing widens permissions) or held for a human (suggestion mode).
before: target.actionId: from the actions list, or target.slug + target.name for a new action

examples.title: Change an action's code with one test

traps.then: a human must approve it: poll promotion_status (or kitsuden_proposal_status with proposal.id); do not resubmit
turbo never widens permissions: a human decides. Drop the new scope/host if you do not need it

traps.if: a test calls kitsuden.api and gets 404
traps.then: tests never reach the real API: add the response under `api` ("GET /api/...") in that test

post.description: Makes the version the action's active code, with a watch window that rolls back automatically on errors. An agent can NOT call this by itself (403, even with `admin`): it only runs as the execution of the agent's proposal after a human approved it. An admin can activate a version that was approved but could not be activated (code actions were disabled). 409 if the action changed since the draft was tested (stale_base) or code actions are disabled (code_actions_disabled: the version stays approved).
